essence: Performing tarpaṇa and related rites makes the mantra ready for ritual application
Offering an oblation with lotus leaves effects the subjugation of the world
Oblation with jasmine flowers assuredly produces subjugation of the world
The practitioner rejoices with nine divine maidens
One should drink brown-cow ghee mixed with dūrvā juice
